judged_text: The only test asserts `Admin::EmbeddingController < Admin::AdminController` and never issues a request, so the show/update serialization contract that the new JS store hydration depends on is completely unverified. The payload shape the new _hydrateEmbedded plural-ids path consumes (root 'embedding' with embeddable_host_ids side-load) has no test — if the serializer emits a shape the store mishandles, the admin embedding page renders an empty hosts table with CI green; the update action, which persists nothing (it only re-renders the OpenStruct built in fetch_embedding), also ships unverified.

adjudication.rationale: The diff adds new admin endpoints/serializers (`Admin::EmbeddingController#show/#update`, `EmbeddingSerializer` with `has_many :embeddable_hosts, embed: :ids`) and client-side hydration changes in `store.js.es6` to support plural `*_ids`, but the only Ruby controller specs added (`spec/controllers/admin/embedding_controller_spec.rb` and `.../embeddable_hosts_controller_spec.rb`) merely assert inheritance and do not exercise any request/response payload shape. There is also no request/spec coverage confirming the `root: 'embedding'` + `embeddable_host_ids`/sideload contract that the new JS admin embedding page relies on. This is a concrete, diff-grounded testing gap rather than a directly verifiable runtime defect from the diff alone.
